BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why do green olives come in jars and black olives come in cans? ASSISTANT:

The difference in packaging between green olives and black olives is due to the type of olive. Green olives are typically packaged in jars, which allows for the flavor to be maintained, while black olives are typically packaged in cans due to their higher acid content which makes them better suited to the preservation process.
